title: AFC playoff picture: Denver Broncos fall to the 5th seed during their bye week

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: AFC playoff picture: Denver Broncos fall to the 5th seed during their bye week
sources.description: A look at the AFC playoff picture after Week 10 of the 2026 regular season. The Denver Broncos entered the bye with the #2 seed, leave it with the #5 seed.
